nodes.label: ActionKind Enum (Advisory LLM Label)
nodes.rationale: ActionKind (HOST/ENGINE/HYBRID) has zero runtime dispatch effect. Its only effect is appending a label to the action description in the LLM system prompt. Phase 4 audit flags this as a misleading name that implies behavioral constraints that are unenforced. Proposed rename to ActionHint or ActionExecution with explicit 'advisory only' documentation.

nodes.label: Observation Merge Order (Two Systems)
nodes.rationale: Two architecturally disconnected observation systems: Python ObservationRegistry+ObservationProvider and Unity ObservationCollector+ObservationProviderBase. Merged in AgentRuntime._build_observation() by strict priority (last write wins). Engine-injected fields (agent_id, inventory etc.) always overwrite everything at priority 4. A provider writing 'agent_id' is silently clobbered — intentional, documented but not enforced.

nodes.label: ActionResult Three Output Channels
nodes.rationale: Every handler returns one ActionResult with three independent channels: state_mutations (AgentRuntime/StateExtension), side_effects (SocialEffectSubscriber via EventBus), engine_commands (HostedWorld→ConnectionHandler→Unity). These channels are independent; a handler can populate any combination. Phase 4 audit flags state_mutations as stringly-typed with implicit conventions — proposes StateMutations typed dataclass.
